lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: Hi, I'm Anna, the product manager.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: And I'm Mark, the developer on the project.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: Great. Let's go through what we need for the beta launch.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Quick update first: I already fixed the sign-up bug yesterday.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: Perfect, thanks. Mark, can you set up analytics on the landing page?

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Sure, I'll have it done by Wednesday.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: Good. I'll write the release notes by Friday.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: And I'll write a migration script for the old beta users.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: Sounds good.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Maybe we could build a dark mode before the launch, too.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: Let's park that for now.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: Someone also needs to update the app store screenshots before the launch.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Yeah, that has to happen.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Are we launching in Canada at the same time?

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: Good question. Nobody has decided that yet.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: Oh, and about the release notes: Friday won't work, I'm out that day. Let's say Monday instead.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Monday works.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: One more thing. Legal says we can't import the old beta accounts, so we don't need the migration script. Let's drop it.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Okay, noted.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: Great, that's everything. Thanks, Mark.
